packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates (npm, mise, GitHub Actions) merge by themselves once CI is green
Major updates in their own PRs, merged by themselves once CI is green (CI cannot see visual changes in rendered diagrams)

TypeScript minors and majors wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard: typescript-eslint declares peer typescript <6.1.0 and refuses to load with 6.1+/7 (https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/10940); a red 6.1 would also block the grouped non-major PR. typescript-eslint adds TS 7 as a separate "@typescript/native" package, so remove this rule only once its typescript peer range itself covers the new version. matchDepNames keeps an @typescript/native alias out of this rule.
